name: TapeOsc
description: Varispeed oscillator with tape motor start/stop. One platform band-limited saw, square, triangle, or sine runs at tape speed. On NTS-1 mkII, releasing the key starts the stop. microKORG2 has no oscillator note-off, so Release only fades the amp.

params.name: WAVE
params.detail: Waveform: saw, square, triangle, sine. Uses the logue band-limited tables.

params.name: START
params.detail: Tape motor spin-up time in milliseconds (10-2000)

params.name: STOP
params.detail: Tape motor spin-down time in milliseconds (10-4000). On NTS-1 mkII and the website preview, starts when the key is released. microKORG2 cannot start this from the key.

params.name: WOW
params.detail: Wow and flutter depth, 0-100%. 100% is about ±10% tape speed.
